Nextcloud has announced Euro-Office, a European open-source alternative to Microsoft 365 based on a fork of ONLYOFFICE.

The newly released Nextcloud Office Desktop application operates as traditional offline software across Windows, macOS, and Linux while maintaining support for Microsoft OOXML and open document formats.

It includes local font support, digital signing, and optional Nextcloud server synchronization for collaborati…
